integration: Wiz Security Graph attack paths used as prioritization input

exploitation_confirmed.title: SQL Injection -- Confirmed RCE-class data extraction
exploitation_confirmed.exploit: UNION-based SQL injection via productSearch query argument. Extracted: users table (12,847 rows including hashed passwords, emails, addresses), orders table (47,293 rows including payment method data), admin_config table.
exploitation_confirmed.proof_of_exploitation: Extracted admin user record: id=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001, email=admin@techstride.io, passwordHash=[redacted]

exploitation_confirmed.title: SSRF -- ECS Task Credentials Extracted
exploitation_confirmed.exploit: SSRF via unchecked url parameter. Probed http://169.254.170.2/v2/credentials/[task-role-id]. AWS ECS task credentials extracted: AccessKeyId, SecretAccessKey, SessionToken. Used credentials to list S3 buckets and retrieve backup files.
exploitation_confirmed.proof_of_exploitation: AccessKeyId: ASIA[redacted] retrieved. S3 listing: s3://techstride-ecom-backups-prod -- 2,847 objects. Retrieved: backups/2026-07-28/full-db-dump.sql.gz (14.2GB)

exploitation_confirmed.title: Mass Assignment -- Privilege Escalation to SUPERADMIN
exploitation_confirmed.exploit: Authenticated request (regular user token) with body {

exploitation_confirmed.title: JWT Signing Secret Exposed -- Token Forgery
exploitation_confirmed.exploit: Hardcoded fallback secret 'jwt-secret-dev-fallback-2024' used to forge admin JWT. Forged token accepted by all protected endpoints.

not_exploited.reason: No attack modules available for these finding classes.

detail.7: Prompt injection via product review requires AI processing step. Pentera cannot model LLM context propagation.
detail.14: LLM jailbreak requires conversational multi-turn attack. No Pentera attack module for LLM system prompt bypass.
detail.16: trust_remote_code=True attack requires CI compromise + HuggingFace model push. Not an HTTP attack surface.
detail.17: Indirect prompt injection via database-stored product description. Pentera tests HTTP parameters, not stored semantic content.
detail.19: GraphQL subscription WebSocket auth bypass. Pentera's GraphQL module tests over HTTP. WebSocket transport not covered.
detail.20: Subdomain takeover requires external DNS analysis + CloudFront distribution claim. Not in-scope for API penetration test.
detail.21: IDOR via LLM reasoning. Attack surface is natural language, not HTTP parameters. No Pentera module.
detail.22: Vector embedding cross-tenant data leak. Requires understanding of embedding space semantics. No attack module.

wiz_integration.note: Wiz Security Graph provided 3 attack paths as prioritization input. Pentera confirmed 2 as actively exploitable (SSRF->ECS->S3 and mass-assignment->admin). 1 path (IAM role accumulation) was confirmed as a posture risk but not directly exploited in this engagement scope.

summary.coverage_gap_note: Pentera confirmed all tool-findable chains with active exploitation evidence. Zero coverage on LLM-required chains (7, 14, 16, 17, 19, 20, 21, 22). These chains require LLM reasoning to surface -- they are not detectable by pattern-matching or active exploitation tooling.
